relevance_note: A systematic review of 550 published ALXDRD patients ('we identified a total of 550 ALXDRD participants carrying 182 different causative variants in the GFAP gene') whose per-patient data sit in Supplementary Table S2, which is not in this text; only a few individual cases are mentioned with a variant, so those few are extracted.
method_note: Rows built with a short Python script from my reading; every span was checked verbatim by script. The paper is a systematic review/meta-analysis; per-patient data (Supplementary Tables S1-S3) are not in the converted text, so the 550 patients are not extracted. In scope under the v4 passing-mention rule (variant given for a single person): two CNV cases with references (^19 exon 5 deletion; ^20 complete GFAP deletion), two 'private variants found in only one participant' (p.Arg283Ser, p.Arg284Tyr), the adult case with p.Glu312*, the infantile case with p.Val431Aspfs*14, and the only infantile R-to-G case with p.Arg79Gly. Variants named only for groups (p.Arg239Cys, p.Arg79His, p.Glu373Lys, p.Arg376Leu/Gln etc.) were not attributed to individuals. The single homozygous participant mentioned in the Introduction ('With the exception of one participant known to date, all GFAP variants are heterozygous') was not given a row: no variant, reference or other detail. Onset classes (adult/infantile) are the paper's AOO classes; no numeric age is given per person, so ISO fields are null. Transcript ENST00000253408.11 is from the statement that each variant was analysed relative to it; not applied to the CNVs. Possible inconsistencies: the adult AOO class is '> 13 years' in the Introduction but '> 12 years' in Results; Methods say articles without SNVs or indels were excluded, yet two CNV cases are counted; reference 19, cited for the exon 5 deletion, is titled 'The neuroanatomy of pure apraxia of speech in stroke' (possible citation numbering error); a 2026 correction says some Table S2 variants were misclassified as frameshift rather than in-frame indels (p.Val431Aspfs*14 is called frameshift in the text). No phenotypic features are reported for any individual; all checklist items are not reported.
